name: Strategy002 oversold RSI+Stoch+BB-low+Hammer
author: Gerald Lonlas (freqtrade-strategies)
indicators: RSI(14); STOCH slowk (default 5,3,3); Fisher RSI=(exp(2x)-1)/(exp(2x)+1), x=0.1*(RSI-50); Bollinger(20,2) on typical price; SAR(default); TA-Lib CDLHAMMER
entry_long: RSI<30 AND slowk<20 AND close<BB_lower AND CDLHAMMER==100
implementation_notes: Hammer pattern + three oversold filters = very rare signals; check trade count. Long-only. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
